# LegatorOCR v0.2.0-pre.31 (pre-release)

Changes since pre.30. Written and tried by the author's assistant on one Linux machine. The automated test suite passes on CI runners for Linux x86-64 and arm64, Windows x86-64 and arm64, and macOS (Apple silicon and Intel); a smoke step also runs the command line on a generated page on each of them. **Nothing was tried by hand on Windows, macOS or arm64, and no photo batch was processed there.**

**Documentation only; the program is the same as in pre.30.**
- **README in eight languages**: `README.md` (English) plus `README.<xx>.md` for Română, Français, Italiano, Español, Português, Deutsch and Magyar, each with a language bar and a version line.
- **User guide as PDF in eight languages** (`-ghid.pdf` for Romanian, `-ghid.<xx>.pdf` for the others). The screenshots are the same in every language and show the Romanian or English interface.
- **Video tour of the window** (11 silent clips, introduced in pre.30) now has subtitles in all eight languages, and the *Window tour* section of the project page follows the page language (clip titles, subtitles, links to the README and guide of each language).
- The clips were recorded from the pre.30 build on Linux with generated sample scans and the English interface; the About window in clip 11 shows pre.30.

**Verified**: unit tests and clippy (unchanged code); CI on the nine jobs; every translated README has the same headings, table rows, code blocks and links as the English one, every translated guide the same images, tables and placeholders as the Romanian original, every subtitle file the same timestamps as the English one; the project page was exercised in a browser in all eight languages.
**Not verified**: the **wording of the translations has not been reviewed by native speakers** (they were written by the author's assistant); interface names quoted in the guides come from the program's language files where available, otherwise they are natural renderings; the GUI on Windows, macOS and arm64; real photos on those systems; the winget manifest (still pre.28, not validated).

**Known limits** (unchanged): photos that are not pages are kept; a large hand holding the page can stay; small notches where a finger was removed; a folded page corner can be cut diagonally; tables and contents pages read few words; OCR can misread characters such as `@`.
